core.method: Single causal binding family, fitted jointly with pose. UpLeg→existingHips/Spine blend only above actual femoral headZ, C1 ramp over90mm. Regional posteriorSpine1→Spine below actualSpine1head with C1 70mm upper collar; x/y feathers preserve anterior/lateral torso. No exterior/Basis/UV/rest edit.

raise.method: One all151-frame linear minimax C2 field with exact native unit-DQ sensitivities. New canonical source has no inherited joint/flank target. Constant root/settled pose/binding stay fixed. No per-frame position cache.
